principle_violations.reason: The Order class has multiple responsibilities: managing order items and their details, as well as handling payment status updates.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the payment processing functionality into a distinct class which handles payments only, while the Order class should focus on order management.

principle_violations.reason: The payment processor classes need to be modified for any new types of payment processing, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use a design pattern such as Strategy or Factory to create payment processors, allowing the addition of new payment methods without modifying existing code.
